instruction: Disable the presenter console in LibreOffice Impress.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Tools > Options > Load/Save > General, enabled auto-save checkbox, changed interval from 10 to 3 minutes, and clicked OK.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice menus, open Options dialog, navigate dialog tree, enable/disable checkboxes, change settings, confirm with OK
metadata.task_rationale: Related but different settings task — model proved it can navigate Options dialog, so this tests navigating to a different settings section (LibreOffice Impress > General) to disable presenter console.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the presenter console. Evaluator uses official check_presenter_console_disable metric which parses registrymodifications.xcu for the presenter console setting under LibreOffice Impress section.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches registrymodifications.xcu, which is the LibreOffice config file where presenter console settings are stored.
Metric check_presenter_console_disable correctly parses XML and checks EnablePresenterScreen under /org.openoffice.Office.Impress/Misc/Start, returning 1.0 if 'false' (disabled).
Instruction has a single requirement (disable presenter console) and the evaluator fully covers it.
Metric is an official existing function in the codebase with proven logic for this exact task.

Minor concern: metric has a 1-parameter signature (no expected param) while evaluator config provides expected.rules={}. The empty rules are semantically unused, which is acceptable since the metric is self-contained.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider removing the expected.rules={} from the evaluator config since the metric does not use a second parameter, to avoid confusion and static validation warnings.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric signature may be invalid (<2 args): check_presenter_console_disable
metric check_presenter_console_disable has no second parameter but expected.rules is provided
